Fit one Bayesian coverage model in a background worker

Source: R/page-bayesian.R
cd_bayes_fit_task.Rd

Hands one fit to a future worker and returns at once. The worker runs generate_bayes_model() on the coverage data, overall score, indicator and denominator in inputs, with cd2030.core attached and a parallel-safe random seed. The Bayesian page uses this function as the task of its shiny::ExtendedTask. With the default sequential plan the fit runs in the calling process; see cd_start_bayes_workers().

Usage

cd_bayes_fit_task(inputs)

Arguments

inputs

A list with key, coverage_data, overall_score, indicator and denominator, as the dataset's bayes_model_inputs() method returns (CacheConnection).

Value

A promise of a list with two elements: key, which is inputs$key unchanged, and model, the fitted model. The key lets the caller keep the model for the request it was fitted for.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
cache$set_national_estimates(list(sbr = 0.02))
cache$adjust_data()

# one fit, kept in the dataset when it ends (it takes minutes)
inputs <- cache$bayes_model_inputs("national", "penta3")
promises::then(cd_bayes_fit_task(inputs), function(out) cache$keep_bayes_model(out$key, out$model))

# in a Shiny server: the task of an ExtendedTask
fit <- ExtendedTask$new(cd_bayes_fit_task)
fit$invoke(inputs)
} # }
